_comment_embedding_mode: Decision 2026-09: use 'tile' (v3, the authors' full-tile / spatial-token-map approach), not 'bbox' (v7, adaptive bounding box) -- tile scored slightly better on IMMUcan. bbox kept available for comparison, not deleted.

defaults._comment_tile: tile_size/tile_stride are for --embedding-mode tile (v3), same value on both datasets. cHL's images are ~11x more pixels than IMMUcan's (2048x1536 vs 600x600), so expect proportionally more forward passes per image -- a runtime, not accuracy, concern.

cHL_2_MIBI._comment_exclude_markers: Histone H3/dsDNA/anti-H2AX (pS139)/pSLP-76/SLP-76: same 5 excluded for every method on cHL. CD161/CD153 (CD30L)/CD28/IL-10 additionally excluded: no match in Eva's marker_to_gene dict (eva/project/utils/constant.py, 213 entries) under any plausible spelling, and Eva's embedding layer does a plain dict lookup with no fallback (hard KeyError on an unmatched name). Eva sees 37 markers here, KRONOS1 sees 41.
cHL_2_MIBI._comment_marker_name_map: Checked against eva/project/utils/constant.py's marker_to_gene dict (Eva's naming is inconsistent with ours, e.g. 'RORgammaT' not 'RORgT', 'PDL1' not 'PD-L1') -- every entry below resolves to a real key.
